items.detail: Help shape the future of Creekside Park! Join us for a community input meeting where residents can share their feedback and vote on their favorite playground equipment colors. Your vote will help bring the new playground to life with a look the community loves. Rainout location is at the Administration Center, 410 N. Arlington Heights Road. If you cannot attend the meeting, you can view playground options and submit your vote in an online survey. Creekside Playground Survey
items.title: Community Input Meeting - Creekside Park

items.detail: Looking for a fun, Halloween themed night out with the family? Join us to continue a well-loved tradition– pumpkin carving! Bring your favorite carving knives and we will provide the rest, including pumpkins, paint, decorations, and, most importantly, the messy clean up. No prior carving knowledge is necessary for this program, just show up, have fun and get creative. Registration is required and the fee is $36 per family ($26 per Historical Society families) Register
items.title: Halloween Pumpkin Carving

items.detail: Join us for Trunk or Treat on Saturday, October 24th, at Pioneer Park from 10AM-12:30PM! Dress in your favorite costume to trick-or-treat at 40+ trunks and booths, enjoy inflatables and a giant slide, meet some Star Wars characters, and get a souvenir photo strip from the photo booth. Our Halloween DJ will pump up the party for the best Monster Bash around! Ages 2-13. Children must be registered and accompanied by an adult – $10 pre-registration through noon on Friday, 10/23. Walk-in registration at $15 at Pioneer Park only from 9am to 12pm on Saturday, 10/24. Adults do not need to register. Register Generously sponsored by:
items.title: Trunk or Treat

Enjoy a shorter, more informal take on the beloved musical, filled with toe-tapping music, hilarious mischief, memorable characters and plenty of heart. Come see the Senior Center bring this classic story to life! Purchase Tickets

items.detail: Pumpkins are 90% water, which makes them bad for landfills but great for soil and gardens! Bring your post-Halloween jack-o-lanterns, gourds, and pumpkins to Frontier Park on Saturday, November 7, from 9AM-12PM, and help the Park District’s EnviroGroup smash and pitch them into compostable material. FREE EVENT!
items.title: Pumpkin Smash: From Gourd to Garden

items.detail: Drop in anytime between 10AM-7PM to honor our Arlington Heights’ Veterans. View our current exhibit, “Stars & Stories: Arlington Heights’ Old Glory,” make a flag, write a Veteran a thank you card and learn about artifacts from our very own Civil War veterans.
items.title: Veterans Day at the Museum

items.detail: Calling all 6th-8th graders – we’re opening the Arlington Ridge Center just for you! Join us for a night of open swim, open gym, pizza, and Spongebob the Movie! $16 pre-registration (open through November 12), $18 at the door. Space is limited. Refunds will only be issued for requests submitted via our website or in writing at least one week prior to the event. Register
items.title: Teen Night - Bikini Bottom Bash

items.detail: Kick off the holiday season with the Arlington Heights Park District and the Village of Arlington Heights Special Events Commission at our annual North School Park tree lighting ceremony! Enjoy holiday-inspired music and dance performances, buy a hot cocoa or tasty treat, visit the AHML Bookmobile, and join the countdown as we flip the switch on over 100,000 tiny lights. Pre-performances in the North School Park amphitheater begin at 4:30PM followed by remarks at 5PM and the lighting ceremony at 5:15PM. Don’t miss the Free Family Fun and coordinated countdown at Harmony Park from 4:30-6:30pm with live reindeer, ice carving, caroling and more! Trolleys with Dickensian characters loop between the two parks, so catch a ride and see it all!
items.title: Holiday Tree Lighting

items.detail: Join us in your holiday best or favorite PJs for a ride on the Holly Jolly Trolley to visit Santa! Your adventure begins at Pioneer Park where our Elf Ticket agents will check you in for Polar Express story-time and a ride with our Polar Express Conductor to the Arlington Lakes Golf Course. At Arlington Lakes, you’ll meet Santa in the Hearth Room, take photos at the Elfie Station, and enjoy hot cocoa and cookies before catching the trolley back to Pioneer. Register for your preferred time slot. Register
items.title: Holly Jolly Trolly

items.detail: Come celebrate winter Jack Frost style at the Arlington Heights Historical Museum! Mail a letter to the North Pole, meet a real-life Ice Princess, Ice Queen and winter animal ambassadors, enjoy cocoa and cookies, join in on Frosty the Snowman story-time, make a snowman craft, listen to strolling carolers, visit with Santa, and more. It’s free, frosty, family fun from 10AM-12:30PM!
items.title: Frostival

items.detail: Helping to continue a well-loved tradition, families will receive all of the materials to build their very own gingerbread house! Hopefully you use more candy then you eat as you decorate as much or as little as you’d like with an assortment of candy provided. No baking necessary for this program, just show up, have fun and get creative. Register ONE family member – fee listed is the per family rate. $36 NM/$26 M, Registration is required. Register
items.title: Family Gingerbread House Decorating

items.detail: All aboard our Storytime Train! On the train to and from Harvard, our conductor will read the Polar Express storybook, and we’ll enjoy music, a snack, and a special visit from Santa. The event begins and ends at the Arlington Heights Train Station in downtown Arlington Heights: train departs from AH at 9:15AM and returns to AH at 11:30AM. Please Note: So that we may include as many children as possible at this beloved event, we kindly ask no more than 2 adults per family register. Regardless of age, everyone who is riding on the train must pre-register (on-site registration will NOT be available) and all children must be accompanied by a registered adult. If you register your child without an adult, this may result in them losing their spot on the train. Strollers and pets are not allowed on the train. If registration fills before you are able to register all of the members of your family, please register additional family members on that train’s wait list. We manage this wait list carefully and make every effort to include as many passengers as are allowed. Refunds will only be issued for withdrawal requests submitted via our website or in writing to Cari Boyle, Events Supervisor, at cboyle@ahpd.org, by Sunday, December 6, and are subject to a $5 transaction fee per registration. Registration
items.title: Winter Express Storytime Train (9:15AM)
